study: eBOSS DR16 first matched realistic EZmock mock-GALAXY cross-Landy-Szalay estimator pilot, no observed odd access
prerequisite_next_step: After the four exact source SHAs are produced, upload unchanged JSON and freeze those four full-byte SHA256 values in a separate follow-up protocol BEFORE opening any galaxy FITS rows. Do not run this galaxy pilot yet.
matching_data_and_random: Same realistic v1_0_0 realization 0001, same Galactic cap, tracer-specific dat and ran; never use observed data or borrow randoms from a different mock ID for this pilot.

sampling.seed_formula: seed_root + 10000*cap_index + 100*tracer_index + (0 for mock galaxy D or 1 for matched mock random R); indexes follow listed caps/tracers order
sampling.first_elg_chunk_sampling: Uniform eligible ELG row sample across the exact published cap's chunks, preserve and report original chunk labels; no chunk-conditioned oversampling, reweighting or merging across Galactic caps.
sampling.if_insufficient_rows: INCOMPLETE_STOP; never silently change sample size, cap, mock, bin or seed.

weights.zero_weight_rule: WEIGHT_SYSTOT <= 1e-12 excludes only previously defined numerical-zero mock rows; fail on nonfinite or significantly negative input

estimator.xi: (DD/n_DD - DR/n_DR - RD/n_RD + RR/n_RR) / (RR/n_RR), only where RR>0
estimator.reverse_mapping: DD->DD, DR->RD, RD->DR, RR->RR, signed mu mirror

fixed_algorithmic_checks.uncovered_mu_cells: record nan and support mask, not zero-filled to infer a physical odd multipole

permitted_outputs: input full compressed SHA256 and fixed source keys
eligible and retained rows in fixed bin; numerical-zero counts; ELG exact chunk counts before/after fixed sampling
deterministic selected array SHA256s and four weighted pair norm/count aggregate summaries
RR supported cell counts and forward/reverse closure metrics
mock galaxy cross-xi descriptive diagnostics with no p value or reported detection
forbidden_outputs: new angular intersection or posterior science cut
physical null or covariance inference from a single mock
inference_status: One mock and finite 600D/1200R per tracer per cap are a computational/normalization pilot ONLY. The fixed nine mocks are themselves still an input/window pilot, not an inferential covariance ensemble.
